name: Patchouli Knowledge's Surprise
source:
You decide to seek out someone who's been looking for you; that person is none other than Patchouli Knowledge! She seems to have a surprise prepared, but what could it be?

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1518670]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你决定寻找一直在寻找你的人；那人不是别人，正是广藿知识！她似乎准备了一个惊喜，但这会是什么？

[编辑自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1518670]Steam[/url]]
